The paper’s explicit benchmarking is only against a single baseline: “In Fig. 1, we show the posterior distributions from the conventional full-parameter sampling and the FIREFLY” and “Figure 2 further shows the time scaling of the two methods.” It does not provide a broader comparison to other existing QNM-extraction approaches beyond conventional full-parameter sampling.

The paper does extensively compare FIREFLY to the existing standard approach in terms of both speed and accuracy, stating 'In simulations including six QNMs, FIREFLY—with high fidelity—yields a ~200 times speedup over the conventional approach' and providing detailed time scaling (Fig. 2) and accuracy assessments via Wasserstein distances (Appendix D).
